title.en: An Act Establishing a Secondary School in Barangay Sinawilan, Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao del Sur to be known as the Sinawilan National High School and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Secondary School in Barangay Sinawilan, Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao del Sur to be known as the Sinawilan National High School and appropriating funds therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học tại Barangay Sinawilan, Thị trấn Matanao, Tỉnh Davao del Sur được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Sinawilan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Sinawilan, เทศบาล Matanao, จังหวัด Davao del Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Sinawilan
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Sinawilan, Kotamadya Matanao, Provinsi Davao del Sur dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Sinawilan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Sinawilan, Perbandaran Matanao, Wilayah Davao del Sur dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Sinawilan

text.en: A secondary school in Barangay Sinawilan, Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao del Sur shall be established under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports to be known as the Sinawilan National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
